name: Wagtail & Co
oneLiner: Small-pack dog day care and walking in Sydney's inner west — the day journalled as your dog lives it.
paletteSeed: cream paper, warm brown ink (never black), clay/terracotta as the act colour, sage support, butter for hand-drawn accents — softness carried by irregular shapes and paper warmth, not pastels
typeDirection: Baloo 2 (rounded display warmth, confident at scale) + Karla (humanist body) + Gochi Hand (the handwriting register: journal annotations, the honest asides) — all OFL, vendored
motionBudget: gentle only, nothing thunks: a leash line draws itself down the day journal with scroll, entries ease in as they arrive, the hero blob mask breathes on a slow loop, polaroids straighten on hover, the crayon underline sits still; reduced-motion gets everything static and the line pre-drawn; no-JS shows the whole day
